summary: Senior Manager, Risk Analytics & Modelling candidate with ~7 years across instrument risk modelling, derivatives valuation, and market risk measurement for institutional portfolios. Delegated sign-off authority at Moody's Analytics on valuation, sensitivity, and risk outputs ($5–25bn per engagement); designed and built an enterprise multi-asset cash-flow projection engine and production Python analytics pipelines, with agentic AI (LLM) workflows in daily use. VaR/CVaR portfolio optimization, stochastic scenario generators, and pension LDI at Ortec Finance. CFA charterholder; dual MSc.

sections.heading: Instrument Risk Modelling & Derivatives Valuation
bullets: Hold delegated sign-off authority on valuation, sensitivity, and risk outputs for multi-asset institutional portfolios ranging $5–25bn per engagement, cumulatively covering ~$50bn of client assets.

Validate derivatives pricing outputs across rates, FX, and inflation on the PFaroe DB (risk & ALM) and PFaroe PM (portfolio management) platforms; cross-check sensitivities and scenario impacts at portfolio-level aggregates for institutional clients including pension funds, asset managers, and their portfolio managers.
Review curve construction, spread calibration, and cross-asset interactions prior to production release; escalate outputs lacking mathematical or economic defensibility.

sections.heading: Risk Tool Development, Scenario Analysis & Risk Reporting
bullets: Led design and implementation of an enterprise multi-asset cash-flow projection engine supporting base, stress, and reverse-stress scenarios across portfolio horizons.
Architected configurable time-bucketed exposure and liquidity analytics (T+1 through multi-year) supporting hedging, funding, and asset-allocation decisions.
Oversaw interest-rate and duration analysis under parallel and non-parallel shocks; prepared analytical commentary translating quantitative outputs into investment-committee-ready risk reports.

sections.heading: Python Engineering, AI Agents & Model Validation
bullets: Re-engineered manual spreadsheet workflows into scalable, auditable Python analytics pipelines (pandas, NumPy) with embedded logging and validation controls — in production across the modelling team.

Built agentic AI development workflows leveraging LLMs (Claude Code, Cursor IDE) — automating code generation, validation scaffolding, anomaly detection, and documentation; reduced cycle time ~30–40% on comparable modules.

Member of the model governance committee — contribute to methodology review and challenge, documentation and benchmarking standards, and assessment of model performance for client-delivered analytics.

Led onboarding and implementation of PFaroe DB and PFaroe PM — vendor risk systems for pension ALM and multi-asset portfolio analytics — for U.S. and Canadian pension funds, asset managers, and consulting firms.

Served as technical liaison and platform point-of-expertise between client investment teams and product/development functions — scoped requirements, advised on asset, liability, and ALM configurations, and validated model outputs post-deployment.
Contributed to the successful migration of all assigned client accounts from a legacy Calypso environment to the PFaroe PM platform.

roles.title: Senior Consultant, IFRS & Financial Risk Transformation

bullets: Delivered IFRS 17 and IFRS 9 transformation projects for Canadian and international insurance clients — aligned liability measurement and reporting frameworks with system implementation.
Advised actuarial, finance, IT, and risk functions on governance documentation, model controls, and regulatory readiness across complex insurer balance sheets.

Built and interpreted stochastic economic scenario generators (Monte Carlo) assessing interest-rate, inflation, and currency risk under base and stressed environments; performed hedging analysis across rates, inflation, and FX.

Performed asset-only and asset-liability (surplus) portfolio optimization based on VaR and CVaR using Ortec's GLASS vendor risk system; conducted risk decomposition, contribution-to-risk, and near-optimal frontier robustness analysis.

Delivered ALM studies for Canadian and international pension funds — analyzed funding ratios, duration mismatch, and long-term balance-sheet risk, modelling actuarial liabilities alongside all major investment-product types and economic variables.

Conducted liability-driven investment (LDI) analysis trading off return objectives, duration alignment, and liquidity; presented findings to investment committees on Strategic and Tactical Asset Allocation through stress and sensitivity testing.

Led onboarding and the ALM study for the University Pension Plan (UPP) three-plan merger — on a team of three, developed and validated the model capturing funding-policy dynamics, evaluating duration, currency, inflation, and leverage overlay strategies.

education: MSc, Chemical Engineering (Full Scholarship) — Western University, 2016
